class.name: SteamServerStatsEdit
class.brief_description: Branchable edits to one player's published Steam GameServer progression.
class.description: Each edit returns a new branch. Stage at most 32 changes with nonempty Steam API names of at most 127 UTF-8 bytes. [method submit] loads the cache if necessary and validates all names and readable types before calling setters. Steam applies setters individually. If a later setter fails, the receipt reports the accepted count and rejected index. Accepted cache changes can remain in Steam. An explicit [method SteamServerPlayerStats.store] can persist them without replaying the setters.

method.name: set_int
method.description: Stage an absolute signed 32-bit value for the published integer stat [param name].

method.name: set_float
method.description: Stage an absolute finite value representable as a Steam single-precision float for [param name].

method.name: update_average_rate
method.description: Stage a finite accumulated [param count] over a finite, positive elapsed duration in [param seconds] for the published AVGRATE stat [param name].

method.name: unlock
method.description: Stage an unlock for the published server-writable achievement [param name].

method.name: clear_achievement
method.description: Stage clearing the published server-writable achievement [param name]. Submit only for a deliberate reset.

method.name: submit
method.description: Submit this exact draft once and return its retained observation. Repeated calls return the same operation, including after failure or cancellation. A successful edit receipt confirms Steam's native StoreUserStats response. An invalid draft settles with [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] before issuing Steam work. Use a new draft for a different game action.
